deadline.value: The chemistry programme page gives no application deadline.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Before admission you need a supervision commitment (Betreuungszusage) from an examiner in the chemistry programme.
supervisor.quote: eines/einer Prüfungsberechtigten im Promotionsstudiengang Chemie für das Promotionsprojekt

funding.value: University-wide, the research group or department usually funds doctoral students by contract or scholarship; this is not a guarantee for every applicant.
funding.quote: Usually, the research group or department provides funding to their doctoral students in the form of either an employment contract or a scholarship

entry_route.value: You need a relevant consecutive Master's and at least four years of total study.
entry_route.quote: Fachlich einschlägiger konsekutiver Master-Studiengang (mind. 1 Jahr Regelstudienzeit) und eine Gesamtstudiendauer von mindestens 4 Jahren

english_waiver.value: English is not tested if your bachelor's was taught in English; an English-medium bachelor's from India therefore meets the English rule.
english_waiver.quote: Sprache Ihres Bachelor-Studiengangs nicht Englisch ist, müssen Sie ausreichende Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache auf dem Niveau C1 GER nachweisen.

also.quote: Falls Ihre Muttersprache oder die Sprache Ihres Bachelor-Studiengangs nicht Deutsch ist, müssen Sie ausreichende Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache auf dem Niveau DSH-2 oder vergleichbar nachweisen.

notes: Applicants whose bachelor's was not taught in German must also prove German at DSH-2 (quoted under english_waiver). This is stricter than the English rule for Indian applicants. Funding quote is the university-wide statement. The Catalysis for Sustainable Synthesis (CaSuS) thematic programme is not saved separately.
